name: Hurley Blackbreath
label: Quest
description: Hurley Blackbreath: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Dark Iron dwarves, led by the villain Hurley Blackbreath, stole one of the Thunderbrew's best recipes, Thunderbrew Lager. The villains! They don't deserve such a fine brew!
Friend, I have a tough task for you. Go to the Blackrock Depths in the Burning Steppes, destroy any kegs of Thunderbrew Lager you find, and bring back our recipe for Thunderbrew Lager!
Please, get that recipe back, even if you have to turn Blackrock Depths upside down to do it!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the recipe, friend? I can't stand the idea of those Dark Iron dwarves drinking my family's drink!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found it! Well done! And I hope you gave those Dark Irons, and Hurley Blackbreath, a good thumping!
The Thunderbrews are at your service, friend. You are a hero of heroes!
